abstract: This paper investigates the estimation of the double autoregressive (DAR) model in the presence of skewed and heavy-tailed innovations. We propose a novel Normal Mixture Quasi-Maximum Likelihood Estimation (NM-QMLE) method to address the limitations of conventional quasi-maximum likelihood estimation (QMLE) under non-Gaussian conditions. By incorporating a normal mixture distribution into the quasi-likelihood framework, NM-QMLE effectively captures both heavy-tailed behavior and skewness. A critical contribution of this paper is addressing the often-overlooked challenge of selecting the appropriate number of mixture components, $K$, a key parameter that significantly impacts model performance. We systematically evaluate the effectiveness of different model selection criteria. Under regularity conditions, we establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the NM-QMLE estimator for DAR($p$) models. Numerical simulations demonstrate that NM-QMLE outperforms commonly adopted QMLE methods in terms of estimation accuracy, particularly when the innovation distribution deviates from normality. Our results also show that while criteria like BIC and ICL improve parameter estimation of $K$, fixing a small order of components provides comparable accuracy. To further validate its practical applicability, we apply NM-QMLE to empirical data from the S\&P 500 index and assess its performance through Value at Risk (VaR) estimation. The empirical findings highlight the effectiveness of NM-QMLE in modeling real-world financial data and improving risk assessment. By providing a robust and flexible estimation approach, NM-QMLE enhances the analysis of time series models with complex innovation structures, making it a valuable tool in econometrics and financial modeling.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在存在偏态和重尾创新情形下双自回归（DAR）模型的估计问题。我们提出了一种新颖的正态混合拟极大似然估计（NM-QMLE）方法，以解决传统拟极大似然估计（QMLE）在非高斯条件下的局限性。通过将正态混合分布纳入拟似然框架，NM-QMLE有效捕捉了重尾行为和偏态特性。本文的一个关键贡献在于处理了常被忽视的混合成分数量\(K\)的选择难题，这一关键参数对模型性能有显著影响。我们系统评估了不同模型选择标准的有效性。在正则条件下，我们确立了NM-QMLE估计量对于DAR(\(p\))模型的一致性和渐近正态性。数值模拟表明，当创新分布偏离正态时，NM-QMLE在估计精度上优于常用的QMLE方法。我们的结果还显示，尽管BIC和ICL等准则能改善参数\(K\)的估计，但固定较小阶数的成分也能提供相当的精度。为进一步验证其实用性，我们将NM-QMLE应用于标普500指数的实证数据，并通过风险价值（VaR）估计评估其性能。实证结果凸显了NM-QMLE在建模真实金融数据和改进风险评估方面的有效性。通过提供一种稳健且灵活的估计方法，NM-QMLE增强了对具有复杂创新结构的时间序列模型的分析，使其成为计量经济学和金融建模中的宝贵工具。
title: Robust Estimation of Double Autoregressive Models via Normal Mixture QMLE*
title_zh: 基于正态混合QMLE的双自回归模型稳健估计

abstract: Stochastic frontier models have attracted considerable attention due to the incorporation of an inefficiency term in addition to the conventional error term. In this paper, we propose a general estimation framework for panel stochastic frontier models that accommodates potential heterogeneity through latent group structures. The framework is tailored to the distinctive features of stochastic frontier models and is paired with a practical hybrid estimation procedure that combines individual-level and joint panel estimation. We illustrate the estimation framework using a panel stochastic frontier model that treats the inefficiency term as a random effect, and show that it can be readily extended to a range of fixed effects specifications common in the literature. Simulation studies indicate strong finite-sample performance, and we further demonstrate the practicality of the approach in an empirical application to the cost efficiency of the U.S. commercial banking sector.
abstract_zh: 随机前沿模型因在传统误差项之外引入无效率项而受到广泛关注。本文提出了一种适用于面板随机前沿模型的通用估计框架，该框架通过潜在群组结构来容纳异质性。此框架针对随机前沿模型的独特特征量身定制，并配以结合个体层面与联合面板估计的实用混合估计程序。我们以一个将无效率项视为随机效应的面板随机前沿模型为例说明该估计框架，并展示其可便捷地扩展至文献中常见的多种固定效应设定。模拟研究表明该方法具有较强的小样本表现，且我们进一步通过一项针对美国商业银行部门成本效率的实证应用，展示了该方法的实用性。
title: Panel Stochastic Frontier Models with Latent Group Structures
title_zh: 具有潜在分组结构的面板随机前沿模型

abstract: This paper introduces the Subseries-based Cauchy Combination Test (SCT), a novel procedure for testing encompassing relationships or model validity using identification conditions formulated as multiple moment restrictions. SCT applies to weakly or short-range-dependent data and eliminates the need to estimate high-dimensional covariance matrices. Unlike Wald- or J-type tests, it remains reliable in both low- and high-dimensional settings. The test is asymptotically unbiased and near-minimax-rate optimal, with asymptotic power no less than that of an oracle max-type test under alternatives in which the selected model fails to encompass the valid model. SCT accommodates redundancy, progression, and nonlinearity testing in rank-deficient systems. As an empirical illustration, we apply SCT to the U.S. factor zoo and show how a handful of factors effectively span the country-level factors over the period 1964–2022.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的子序列柯西组合检验（SCT），该程序用于检验包含关系或模型有效性，其识别条件以多重矩约束形式设定。SCT适用于弱依赖或短程依赖数据，并无需估计高维协方差矩阵。与Wald型或J型检验不同，SCT在低维和高维设置下均保持可靠性。该检验渐近无偏且接近极小极大速率最优，在所选模型未能包含有效模型的备择假设下，其渐近功效不低于预言机最大型检验。SCT支持秩亏系统中的冗余性、递进性和非线性检验。作为实证示例，我们将SCT应用于美国因子动物园，并展示了在1964年至2022年间，少数几个因子如何有效覆盖国家层面因子。
title: Encompassing and Progression Testing in High-Dimensions
title_zh: 高维中的涵盖性与渐进性检验

abstract: In the context of an epidemic where the risk of death post-infection depends on demography and social behaviour, this paper characterises how the degree of congestibility of the social environment and the public/private nature of the available information about health states jointly affect the strategic social distancing of demographically heterogeneous agents. Key result is that the joint presence of congestibility and private information is necessary and sufficient for social-distancing decisions to be strategic complements. Strategic substitutability ensues in every other case. Within the limits of the proposed model, the analysis provides a sound theoretical rationale for the heterogeneity in the results provided by the extant literature on the issue. Implications ensue for optimal information design. First: limiting private information (e.g. by forbidding self-tests) is always socially optimal. Second: if private information cannot be limited, the second-best policy crucially depends on environmental congestibility: with high congestibility, providing the maximum extent of public information (e.g. via mass screening campaigns) is desirable, whereas the converse is true with low congestibility.
abstract_zh: 在感染后死亡风险取决于人口结构和社会行为的流行病背景下，本文刻画了社会环境拥挤程度以及健康状态信息的公共/私人属性如何共同影响人口异质性主体的策略性社交距离行为。关键结论是，拥挤性与私人信息的共同存在是社交距离决策成为战略互补品的充分必要条件。在其他所有情形下，则表现为战略替代性。在模型设定范围内，分析为现有文献中关于该问题结果异质性提供了坚实的理论依据。这对最优信息设计具有启示意义。第一：限制私人信息（例如禁止自我检测）始终是社会最优的。第二：若私人信息无法限制，次优政策则关键取决于环境拥挤程度：在高拥挤性下，提供最大程度的公共信息（例如通过大规模筛查活动）是可取的；而在低拥挤性下，情况则相反。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 249
title: Complementarity, congestion and information design in epidemics with strategic social behaviour
title_zh: 流行病中策略性社会行为下的互补性、拥堵与信息设计

abstract: This paper studies the health consequences of administrative centralization in healthcare, focusing on the consolidation of Local Health Authorities (LHAs) within the Italian National Health Service. This type of reform fits within a broader set of cost-containment efforts aimed at reducing administrative expenditures and exploiting economies of scale. In the Italian case, the reform centralized governance and expanded the scale of health administration, creating authorities with substantially larger catchment areas and shifting decision-making to more heterogeneous jurisdictions. Such changes may affect the responsiveness of healthcare provision to local needs, the coordination of service delivery, and access to care. Using an event-study Difference-in-Differences design, we estimate the policy's impact on municipal mortality rates, accounting for heterogeneous treatment effects and co-occurring fiscal adjustment policies. We find a significant increase in mortality starting four years after implementation, with an average treatment effect on the treated of 2.1%. The effects are concentrated in municipalities belonging to absorbed LHAs and in those exposed to mergers involving relatively large pre-reform LHAs and substantial post-merger expansions in catchment areas; they are also unevenly distributed, creating new vulnerable areas. Welfare estimates based on life-years lost indicate that the monetary costs of increased mortality exceed plausible administrative savings by roughly an order of magnitude.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了医疗行政集权对健康结果的影响，重点关注意大利国家卫生服务体系中地方卫生机构（LHAs）的合并。此类改革属于旨在削减行政开支并利用规模经济的一系列成本控制措施的一部分。在意大利案例中，改革集中了治理权并扩大了卫生行政的规模，形成了覆盖区域显著扩大且决策权转向更具异质性辖区的机构。这些变化可能影响医疗服务对地方需求的响应性、服务提供的协调性以及医疗服务的可及性。利用事件研究双重差分设计，我们评估了该政策对市级死亡率的影响，并考虑了处理效应的异质性及同时实施的财政调整政策。我们发现，政策实施四年后死亡率显著上升，处理组的平均处理效应为2.1%。这一效应集中于被吸收合并的地方卫生机构所在市镇，以及涉及合并前规模相对较大且合并后覆盖区域大幅扩张的地方卫生机构的市镇；同时，该效应分布不均，催生了新的脆弱区域。基于生命年损失的福利估算表明，死亡率上升带来的货币成本大约超过合理的行政节省一个数量级。
title: Consolidation of Local Health Authorities and mortality in the Italian NHS
title_zh: 意大利国家卫生服务体系中地方卫生当局的整合与死亡率

abstract: Worldwide, gambling can cause economic and health-related harm to individuals and communities. Policy responses to reduce these harms require evidence on the effects of features of the gambling environment. This study explores whether geographical accessibility to gambling venues impacts suicides. We construct a longitudinal spatial data set with information on the number of gambling venues and suicides in Australian neighbourhoods from 2001 to 2018, and exploit changes in accessibility induced by venue openings and closures. The closure of a gambling venue is estimated to decrease the number of suicides per year in that area by 9.8%. Effects of gambling venues in neighbouring areas are small and statistically insignificant, indicating that the relationship between venue access and suicide is concentrated close to the venue location.
abstract_zh: 在全球范围内，赌博可能对个人和社区造成经济与健康方面的伤害。为减少这些伤害而制定的政策应对措施，需要基于赌博环境特征影响效应的证据。本研究探讨了赌博场所的地理可及性是否影响自杀行为。我们构建了一个纵向空间数据集，包含2001年至2018年间澳大利亚社区赌博场所数量及自杀情况的信息，并利用场所开业与关闭所引发的可及性变化进行分析。据估计，赌博场所的关闭可使该地区每年的自杀人数减少9.8%。邻近地区赌博场所的影响效应较小且统计上不显著，这表明赌博场所可及性与自杀之间的关系主要集中在场所位置附近。
title: Geographical Accessibility to Gambling Venues and Suicide
title_zh: 赌博场所的地理可达性与自杀

abstract: With the retirement of 21GW of legacy coal fleet looming, the task to replace Australia's thermal capacity with alternative firmed renewable ‘bulk energy’ solutions is non‐trivial. Indeed, calibrating necessary capital investment in new plant stock with efficient economic outcomes, vis‐à‐vis cost and reliability, represents a fundamental challenge to the ‘dynamic efficiency’ ideal for energy‐only markets. Recently, a major review of Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) has proposed that underwriting of new energy generation utilise fungible derivative contracts instead of the canonical run‐of‐plant (RoP) revenue contract design. The proposition is based upon re‐linking medium‐ and long‐term energy markets, while mitigating some of the worst externalities attributed to off‐market underwriting policies when implemented at‐scale. However, sound economic theory can collide with applied corporate finance in practice. The very basis of the RoP design has been to address the needs of capital markets vis‐à‐vis revenue quality for new‐entrant plant, making bankability a threshold issue for contract viability. This article examines a set of proposed fungible contract designs, leveraging 100 years of synthetic, stochastic market data to draw conclusions on the compatibility of contract fungibility and bankability. Findings indicate that eliminating incentive incompatibilities between plant dispatch and market signals (which are inherent in the RoP design) appears adequate to counteract ‘shape’ risk—both idiosyncratic and systematic—within the confines of a typical project finance structure. In other words, bankability and fungibility do not appear to be mutually exclusive.
abstract_zh: 随着21吉瓦传统燃煤发电机组退役的临近，用替代性固定可再生能源“大宗能源”解决方案来填补澳大利亚热力发电能力的任务绝非易事。实际上，将新电厂所需的资本投资与高效的经济成果（就成本和可靠性而言）进行校准，是对仅靠能源市场实现“动态效率”理想的一个根本性挑战。近期，对澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）的一项重大审查提议，新发电项目的承销应采用可互换衍生品合约，而非传统的按电厂运行（RoP）收入合约设计。该提议基于重新连接中长期能源市场，同时减轻大规模实施场外承销政策所带来的一些最严重外部性。然而，健全的经济理论在实践中可能与应用企业财务相冲突。RoP设计的基本出发点在于满足资本市场对新进入电厂收入质量的需求，使得可融资性成为合约可行性的关键问题。本文考察了一系列拟议的可互换合约设计，利用100年的合成随机市场数据，就合约可互换性与可融资性的兼容性得出结论。研究结果表明，消除电厂调度与市场信号之间的激励不兼容性（这是RoP设计固有的）似乎足以在典型项目融资结构范围内抵消“形状”风险——无论是特质性还是系统性风险。换言之，可融资性与可互换性并非相互排斥。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Alternative Contract Design: Analysing the Bankability of Fungible Derivative Contracts in Energy‐Only Markets
title_zh: 替代性合约设计：能量单一市场中可互换衍生品合约的可融资性分析

abstract: Improving diet quality remains a key challenge in post‐poverty rural China. This study examines how women's community participation, a form of public‐sphere agency, relates to household diet quality. We introduce a Food‐Weighted Dietary Diversity Index (FWDDI) that captures variation in diet quality beyond adequacy thresholds in broadly adequate settings and apply it to a three‐wave household panel. Fixed‐effects estimates show a positive association between women's community participation and household diet quality. This association is reflected in broader and more nutrient‐dense diets, with little change in consumption frequency, and in the corresponding pattern in women's intrahousehold decision‐making, consistent with information diffusion and women's decision influence as plausible pathways. This association is concentrated in women's participation in economic activities, among ever‐registered‐poor households and in villages with male agricultural wage premiums. These findings point to women's public engagement, especially in economic activities, as a potential channel for improving household diet quality, particularly where household resource constraints are tighter and women are at a wage disadvantage in local labour markets.
abstract_zh: 改善饮食质量仍是后贫困时代中国农村面临的关键挑战。本研究探讨女性社区参与——一种公共领域能动性形式——如何与家庭饮食质量相关联。我们引入了一个食物加权膳食多样性指数（FWDDI），该指数能够捕捉在总体充足情境下超越充足阈值的饮食质量差异，并将其应用于三轮家庭面板数据。固定效应估计显示，女性社区参与与家庭饮食质量之间存在正向关联。这一关联体现在更广泛且营养密度更高的饮食结构中，而消费频率变化甚微，同时与女性家庭内部决策权的相应模式相吻合，这与信息扩散和女性决策影响力作为合理的作用路径相一致。该关联集中于女性参与经济活动的情形，在曾登记贫困家庭以及存在男性农业工资溢价的村庄中尤为显著。这些发现表明，女性公共参与，尤其是经济活动的参与，是改善家庭饮食质量的潜在渠道，特别是在家庭资源约束更为紧张且女性在当地劳动力市场中处于工资劣势的情况下。

abstract: We study the distributional implications of uncertainty shocks by developing a model that links macroeconomic aggregates to the US distribution of earnings and consumption. Our findings suggest that the fraction of low‐earning workers decreases initially, while the share of households reporting low consumption increases. At longer horizons, the fraction of low‐income workers increases, but the consumption distribution reverts to its preshock shape. While the first phase reduces income inequality and increases consumption inequality, in the second stage income inequality rises, and the effects on consumption inequality dissipate.
abstract_zh: 我们通过构建一个将宏观经济总量与美国收入与消费分布联系起来的模型，研究不确定性冲击的分配效应。研究结果表明，低收入工人比例初期下降，而报告低消费的家庭比例上升。在较长时期内，低收入工人比例增加，但消费分布恢复至冲击前形态。第一阶段降低了收入不平等并加剧了消费不平等，而第二阶段收入不平等上升，对消费不平等的影响则逐渐消散。
title: The Distributional Effects of Economic Uncertainty*
title_zh: 经济不确定性的分配效应

abstract: Recent work suggests that nominal GDP targeting may raise social welfare, but fiscal considerations have largely been ignored. We study an overlapping generations model with government debt and distortionary taxes. Nominal GDP targeting has two opposing effects on the tax burden: mean taxes increase, but tax volatility is reduced. Differently to previous works, we find that nominal GDP targeting lowers social welfare relative to inflation targeting. A key mechanism is that nominal GDP targeting makes inflation countercyclical, thereby raising long run inflation risk and consumption risk of retirees while increasing the inflation risk premium paid on government debt.
abstract_zh: 近期研究指出，名义GDP目标化可能提升社会福利，但财政方面的考量在很大程度上被忽视了。我们研究了一个包含政府债务和扭曲性税收的代际重叠模型。名义GDP目标化对税收负担产生两种相反的影响：平均税收增加，但税收波动性降低。与以往研究不同，我们发现名义GDP目标化相对于通胀目标化降低了社会福利。一个关键机制在于，名义GDP目标化使通胀呈现逆周期特性，从而增加了长期通胀风险及退休人员的消费风险，同时提高了政府债务所支付的通胀风险溢价。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Nominal GDP targeting and the tax burden
title_zh: 名义GDP目标与税收负担

abstract: We investigate the channels through which inflation expectations affect household spending by conducting surveys featuring hypothetical scenarios involving an increase in inflation expectations. Most households did not adjust their current spending plans, often because they perceived inflation expectations as irrelevant or adhered to a fixed budget. Among those who did adjust, most decreased their spending, primarily due to wealth effects. Few households increased spending as prescribed by the traditional intertemporal substitution channel. We also document that financial conditions, cognitive ability, and subjective mental models—such as stagflationary expectations—help predict spending responses and the mechanisms households cite. Our findings provide insights into the discussion of using inflation expectations as a policy tool and highlight key frictions to incorporate into theoretical models.
abstract_zh: 我们通过开展涉及通胀预期上升假设情景的调查，探究了通胀预期影响家庭支出的渠道。大多数家庭并未调整其当前支出计划，这往往是因为他们认为通胀预期无关紧要或坚持固定预算。在确实进行调整的家庭中，多数减少了支出，主要归因于财富效应。少数家庭按照传统跨期替代渠道的指引增加了支出。我们还发现，财务状况、认知能力以及主观心智模型（如滞胀预期）有助于预测支出反应及家庭所引用的机制。我们的研究结果为关于将通胀预期作为政策工具的讨论提供了见解，并强调了需纳入理论模型的关键摩擦因素。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: How Do Households Respond to Expected Inflation? An Investigation of Transmission Mechanisms,
title_zh: 家庭如何应对预期通胀？传导机制研究

abstract: Organizational capacity is widely considered central to whether managers or politicians can deliver complex projects in an efficient manner. Yet in practice performance can depend on the interaction of capacity with a host of factors such as political opposition or regulatory constraints. We develop a dynamic theory of project development that examines these interactions. In the model, higher capacity enables faster progress toward completion, but opposing interests may incur costly delays by attempting to revise the distribution of project payoffs. Project designers can avoid revisions by equalizing distributive benefits or inflating project scales to make delays prohibitively costly. We show that welfare is minimized when both capacity and the ability to revise are moderate. More efficient outcomes are either smaller than socially optimal or have highly unequal distributive outcomes.
abstract_zh: 组织能力被广泛视为管理者或政治家能否高效交付复杂项目的核心要素。然而，在实践中，绩效可能取决于能力与政治反对或监管约束等多种因素的相互作用。我们构建了一个项目开发的动态理论，以考察这些相互作用。在该模型中，更高的能力能加速项目向完成推进，但反对利益方可能通过试图修订项目收益分配来造成代价高昂的延误。项目设计者可以通过均衡分配收益或扩大项目规模使延误成本过高，从而避免修订。我们证明，当能力和修订能力均处于中等水平时，社会福利最小化。更有效的结果要么规模小于社会最优，要么分配结果高度不均。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Organizational Capacity and Project Dynamics,
title_zh: 组织能力与项目动态

abstract: Demand-side food policies are increasingly recognized as important tools for aligning consumption patterns with climate change mitigation targets, and carbon food labels have attracted growing attention as a potential policy instrument. However, evidence on their effectiveness remains mixed, and causal evaluation results from assessing the effects of carbon food labels in real-world supermarket settings is scarce. This study presents evidence from pre-registered randomized field-embedded survey experiment with behavioral outcomes, combining a representative sample of 2,372 Swiss residents with transaction-level purchasing data covering more than five million daily food purchase decisions made by 1,601 consumers over several years. In collaboration with one of Switzerland’s largest grocery retailers, we evaluate the causal impact of an information treatment designed to increase awareness of one of the world’s first carbon food labels implemented in grocery stores on both stated preferences and revealed purchasing behavior. The results show that the information treatment significantly increases label awareness and leads to small but positive effects on attitudes, perceived behavioral control, and intentions to consider the climate compatibility of food purchases. When tracing these effects into revealed purchasing behavior, the treatment also affects actual food purchases, but effects are modest and heterogeneous across food categories. Rather than inducing broad shifts away from meat consumption, the information treatment primarily leads to a higher overall share of labeled products purchased, increased purchases of labeled convenience products, and a partial reallocation within meat consumption (e.g., lower beef and higher pork purchases). We find no evidence of substantial reductions in overall meat purchases or large cross-category substitutions toward plant-based foods. While heavy meat eaters do not react negatively to the treatment, men and more right-wing individuals show a modest behavioral backlash. Overall, the results suggest that carbon food labels capacity to substantially alter habitual food consumption patterns in stimulus-intensive retail environments is limited and should be thus complemented by additional demand-side measures.
abstract_zh: 需求侧食品政策日益被认为是使消费模式与气候变化减缓目标相一致的重要工具，碳食品标签作为一种潜在的政策手段也引起了越来越多的关注。然而，关于其有效性的证据仍然不一，且在真实超市环境中评估碳食品标签影响的因果评价结果十分稀缺。本研究提供了来自预注册的随机实地嵌入调查实验的证据，并结合行为结果，涵盖了2，372名瑞士居民的代表性样本，以及包含1，601名消费者多年间超过五百万次日常食品购买决策的交易级购买数据。我们与瑞士最大的杂货零售商之一合作，评估了一项旨在提高对杂货店中全球首批碳食品标签之一认知度的信息干预对陈述偏好和揭示性购买行为的因果影响。结果显示，信息干预显著提高了标签认知度，并对态度、感知行为控制以及考虑食品购买气候兼容性的意图产生了虽小但积极的影响。在将这些影响追踪至揭示性购买行为时，干预也影响了实际食品购买，但效果温和且在不同食品类别间存在异质性。信息干预并未引发远离肉类消费的广泛转变，而是主要导致所购标签产品总体份额增加、标签便利产品购买量上升，以及肉类消费内部的部分重新分配（例如，牛肉购买减少而猪肉购买增加）。我们未发现总体肉类购买量大幅减少或向植物基食品大规模跨类别替代的证据。尽管重度肉类消费者对干预未表现出负面反应，但男性和更倾向右翼的个体表现出适度的行为反弹。总体而言，结果表明，在刺激密集的零售环境中，碳食品标签显著改变习惯性食品消费模式的能力有限，因此应辅以额外的需求侧措施。
title: zero pu“Carbon food labels have limited effects on grocery shopping behavior: Evidence from a randomized experiment”
title_zh: 碳食品标签对杂货购物行为影响有限：来自随机实验的证据

abstract: Sociological rational choice theory (SRT) is a theoretical approach that values scientifically driven, theoretically grounded research, combining the methodological individualism and instrumental microfoundations used in economics with models of institutions, networks, and norms from sociology. Inspired by the public choice movement, SRT sought to apply rational choice theory to non-market behavior and the collective results of that behavior. At the time of its inception, SRT distanced itself from social exchange theory and the main lines of social network analysis. Whereas exchange theory readily incorporated network concepts and rooted itself in social psychology, advocates for rational choice pursued a strategy based on strong assumptions about individual rationality combined with a more flexible conception of bounded rationality. Despite being promoted by leading sociologists, SRT never attained a position at the center of the discipline, and debate on rational choice gradually died out. Mounting criticism of the rational action model in philosophy, cognitive psychology, and behavioral economics also took a toll on the appeal of rational choice and the confidence of its practitioners. Nevertheless, we conclude on an encouraging note. While American sociology has shown declining interest and involvement in SRT, new directions drawing on social network analysis, experimental methods, and efforts to adapt the dual-process framework of behavior show great promise. To some extent, rational choice sociology informs a vital part of the discipline in the United States and particularly in Europe.
abstract_zh: 社会学理性选择理论（SRT）是一种重视科学驱动、理论扎实的研究方法，它将经济学中的方法论个人主义和工具性微观基础与社会学中的制度、网络和规范模型相结合。受公共选择运动的启发，SRT旨在将理性选择理论应用于非市场行为及其集体结果。在其创立之初，SRT与社会交换理论及社会网络分析的主要流派保持距离。交换理论易于融入网络概念并植根于社会心理学，而理性选择的倡导者则采取了一种基于个体理性强假设与有限理性更灵活概念相结合的策略。尽管得到了顶尖社会学家的推崇，SRT从未成为学科核心，关于理性选择的辩论也逐渐消退。哲学、认知心理学和行为经济学中对理性行动模型的日益批评，也削弱了理性选择的吸引力及其实践者的信心。尽管如此，我们以鼓舞人心的结论收尾。虽然美国社会学对SRT的兴趣和参与度有所下降，但借鉴社会网络分析、实验方法以及适应行为双过程框架的新方向展现出巨大潜力。在某种程度上，理性选择社会学为美国，尤其是欧洲的学科重要组成部分提供了启示。
title: Sociological rational choice theory: retrospect and prospect
title_zh: 社会学理性选择理论：回顾与展望

abstract: Motivated by recent calls for new investment to enhance EU competitiveness, this paper compares intangible capital accumulation in France and Germany, documenting large cross-country differences in investment levels, particularly in software and organizational capital. Yet, both countries have experienced similar labor productivity growth (LPG) from 1995 to 2021, raising questions about investment efficiency and potential measurement issues, especially in light of contrasting evidence from firm-level surveys. To shed further light on this puzzle, we conduct an econometric cross-country sectoral growth accounting analysis based on capital services growth rates. The results show that intangible capital contributed more to LPG in Germany than in France, despite the lower investment levels in the former. We interpret this finding primarily as reinforcing concerns about cross-country measurement inconsistencies and highlight the need for harmonizing intangible capital statistics to support more robust policy comparisons at the EU level.
abstract_zh: 受近期关于提升欧盟竞争力的新投资呼吁的启发，本文比较了法国和德国的无形资本积累情况，记录了在投资水平上的显著跨国差异，尤其是在软件和组织资本方面。然而，两国在1995年至2021年间经历了相似的全员劳动生产率增长，这引发了关于投资效率和潜在测量问题的疑问，尤其是考虑到企业层面调查中呈现的对比性证据。为深入探究这一谜团，我们基于资本服务增长率进行了跨国部门层面的增长核算计量分析。结果显示，尽管德国的投资水平较低，但其无形资本对全员劳动生产率增长的贡献大于法国。我们将这一发现主要解读为加剧了对跨国测量不一致性的担忧，并强调需要统一无形资本统计，以支持欧盟层面更为稳健的政策比较。
title: Is the EU ready for the next generation of investment? A cross-country sectoral growth accounting analysis of intangible capital in France and Germany
title_zh: 欧盟准备好迎接下一代投资了吗？法国与德国无形资产跨国部门增长核算分析

abstract: Bank leverage constraints can arise from regulatory capital requirements or from central bank collateral requirements in reserve lending. We compare these two policy channels within the so-called “bank money creation” approach. We show that monetary policy via collateral requirements leads to a novel and unique collateral leverage channel. Through this channel, banks facing liquidity constraints can expand loan supply and deposit issuance by raising the collateral value of their loans, which they achieve through tighter loan monitoring. The collateral leverage channel can improve welfare beyond standard bank capital regulation and inform the design of central bank collateral frameworks.
abstract_zh: 银行杠杆约束可能源于监管资本要求，或中央银行在储备贷款中的抵押品要求。我们在所谓的“银行货币创造”框架内比较这两种政策渠道。我们表明，通过抵押品要求实施的货币政策引致了一个新颖且独特的抵押品杠杆渠道。通过这一渠道，面临流动性约束的银行可以通过提高其贷款的抵押品价值来扩大贷款供给和存款发行，而这通过更严格的贷款监控实现。抵押品杠杆渠道能在标准银行资本监管之外增进福利，并为中央银行抵押品框架的设计提供参考。
title: Leverage constraints and bank monitoring: Bank regulation versus monetary policy
title_zh: 杠杆约束与银行监督：银行监管与货币政策

abstract: Teams of inventors now produce over 80% of U.S. patents, up from just 45% in 1976. Over the same period, inventor employment has become increasingly concentrated in large firms, rising six times more than overall employment concentration. To explain these trends, we develop a new model of endogenous team formation within firms and embed it in a general equilibrium model of the inventor labor market. Teams increase firms' returns to scale by increasing the likelihood of productive matches between inventors. The value of these matches rise over time, possibly driven by increasing knowledge specialization. This causes large firms to expand and small firms to shrink in equilibrium, accounting for the observed increase in inventor employment concentration. Because firms do not internalize knowledge spillovers, there is misallocation of inventors across firms. The rise of team production amplifies this misallocation by a factor of six by reallocating inventors away from small firms that generate disproportionately large knowledge spillovers.
abstract_zh: 如今，美国超过80%的专利由发明人团队产出，而1976年这一比例仅为45%。同期，发明人就业日益集中于大型企业，其集中度增幅是整体就业集中度的六倍。为解释这些趋势，我们构建了一个企业内团队形成的内生新模型，并将其嵌入发明人劳动力市场的一般均衡模型中。团队通过提高发明人之间有效匹配的可能性，增强了企业的规模报酬。这些匹配的价值随时间上升，可能源于知识专业化程度的加深。这导致均衡状态下大企业扩张、小企业收缩，从而解释了观察到的发明人就业集中度上升现象。由于企业未将知识溢出内部化，发明人在企业间的配置存在错配。团队生产的兴起通过将发明人从小企业重新分配出去，加剧了这种错配，其影响程度放大六倍，而小企业恰恰产生了不成比例的巨大知识溢出。
title: Ideas and Firm Dynamics When It Takes Two to Tango
title_zh: 思想与公司动态：当合作需要双方共舞时

abstract: Agri-food products with geographical indications (GI products) are territorially embedded agricultural systems whose production and value depend on legally defined protection boundaries, rendering them biophysically vulnerable to climate change. Despite extensive examination of terroir-associated climate risks, the heterogeneous climate-driven potential land-use risks across product categories and protection boundaries remain insufficiently understood. Based on 7260 planting occurrence records, this study employs the MaxEnt model to conduct an exploratory simulation of shifts in the suitable areas for 185 Chinese GI products across seven categories under the China-EU GI Agreement. Consequently, it identifies high-risk GI products/categories, assesses their potential sensitivity and pressures from intra- and extra-zone exposure disparities under future climate scenarios. This study addresses three core questions: (i) identifying key environmental variables; (ii) assessing the potential climate sensitivity of specific categories; and (iii) quantifying potential intra- and extra-zone exposure pressures. Results demonstrate that (1) climatic factors constitute the primary biophysical drivers of GI product suitability, followed by topographic and soil factors; (2) Tea & Coffee products exhibit the highest potential climate sensitivity among all categories, while 35 identified high-sensitivity GI products face significant suitable area change or displacement risks; and (3) under future climate scenarios, the potential legal exposure induced by suitability expansion outside designated GI zones is projected to be approximately twice that of the potential moral hazard to product quality arising from environmental mismatches inside, underscoring a profound spatial mismatch between shifting ecological niches and static institutional boundaries. These findings highlight emerging land-use and institutional governance challenges for GI systems under climate change, offering policy insights for empowering entrepreneurial resilience, implementing category-specific interventions, and dynamically adjusting GI protection boundaries.
abstract_zh: 具有地理标志的农产品（GI产品）是根植于特定地域的农业系统，其生产和价值依赖于法律界定的保护边界，因此在生物物理层面易受气候变化影响。尽管关于风土相关气候风险的研究已较为广泛，但不同产品类别及保护边界内由气候驱动的潜在土地利用风险的异质性仍未得到充分理解。基于7260条种植发生记录，本研究采用MaxEnt模型，对中国-欧盟GI协定下七大类185种中国GI产品适宜区变化进行了探索性模拟。据此，识别出高风险GI产品/类别，并评估其在未来气候情景下因区内与区外暴露差异而产生的潜在敏感性与压力。本研究回应三个核心问题：（i）识别关键环境变量；（ii）评估特定类别的潜在气候敏感性；（iii）量化区内与区外潜在暴露压力。结果表明：（1）气候因素是GI产品适宜性的首要生物物理驱动因子，其次为地形和土壤因素；（2）茶与咖啡类产品在所有类别中表现出最高的潜在气候敏感性，而识别出的35种高敏感性GI产品面临显著的适宜区变化或位移风险；（3）在未来气候情景下，因适宜区扩展至指定GI区域之外而引发的潜在法律暴露预计约为因区内环境错配导致产品质量潜在道德风险的2倍，凸显了生态位迁移与静态制度边界之间的深刻空间错配。这些发现揭示了气候变化下GI系统面临的新兴土地利用与制度治理挑战，为增强创业韧性、实施类别差异化干预及动态调整GI保护边界提供了政策启示。

abstract: This paper proposes a Hierarchical Archimedean Copula Risk Parity (HAC-RP) framework that extends the conventional Hierarchical Risk Parity (HRP) approach by incorporating nonlinear and asymmetric dependence through hierarchical Archimedean copulas. Three copula specifications – Gumbel, Clayton, and a multi-generator HAC – are considered within the HRP allocation framework. The proposed method is evaluated using monthly U.S. sector ETF data and compared with conventional HRP, a Ledoit – Wolf global minimum-variance portfolio, and an equal-weight benchmark. Empirical results show that the proposed HAC portfolios provide competitive risk-adjusted performance while maintaining favourable diversification and turnover characteristics. Among the proposed specifications, the multi-generator HAC exhibits the strongest overall performance. These findings suggest that hierarchical copulas provide a practical extension of the conventional HRP framework for portfolio construction. abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种分层阿基米德Copula风险平价（HAC-RP）框架，通过引入分层阿基米德Copula来捕捉非线性及非对称依赖性，从而扩展了传统的分层风险平价（HRP）方法。在HRP配置框架内，考虑了三种Copula设定——Gumbel、Clayton以及多生成元HAC。所提方法利用美国行业ETF月度数据进行评估，并与传统HRP、Ledoit-Wolf全局最小方差组合及等权重基准进行比较。实证结果表明，所提出的HAC组合在保持良好分散化和换手率特性的同时，提供了具有竞争力的风险调整后表现。在所提设定中，多生成元HAC展现出最强的整体表现。这些发现表明，分层Copula为传统HRP框架在组合构建中提供了一种实用的扩展。关键词：风险平价 股票波动率 阿基米德Copula 组合选择 组合表现 JEL分类：G11 C46 C58 致谢 本文发展并大幅扩展了最初发表于金敏珠（Minju Kim）硕士论文中的研究，该论文题为“利用阿基米德Copula捕捉横截面市场波动微笑现象的分层资产配置”，于2023年提交至浦项科技大学（POSTECH）。

abstract: China launched a pilot value-added tax reform in 2004 that allowed eligible firms to deduct input VAT on purchases of fixed assets, thereby lowering the user cost of capital. Using firm-level panel data from 2001 to 2008 and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the reform increased treated firms’ carbon productivity by approximately 28%. The effect emerged gradually and peaked in 2006. Mechanism eviden.ce suggests that the improvement was more closely associated with higher R&D investment and gains in total factor productivity than with simple input expansion. The results suggest that general-purpose investment policies can deliver climate co-benefits by promoting innovation and resource efficiency, even without explicit environmental objectives.
abstract_zh: 中国于2004年启动了增值税改革试点，允许符合条件的企业在购置固定资产时抵扣进项增值税，从而降低了资本使用成本。利用2001年至2008年的企业层面面板数据及双重差分设计，我们发现该改革使受处理企业的碳生产率提高了约28%。这一效应逐步显现，并于2006年达到峰值。机制证据表明，这一改善与研发投入增加及全要素生产率提升的关联更为紧密，而非简单的投入扩张。研究结果表明，即使没有明确的环境目标，通用型投资政策也能通过促进创新和资源效率，带来气候协同效益。

abstract: This study investigates the social, economic, cultural, and infrastructural factors associated with circular economy (CE) practices across 22 districts of Tehran from 2019 to 2023. Using recorded dry waste generation as an imperfect proxy for certain dimensions of circular economy behaviour, the analysis employs conventional and spatial panel data models to capture inter-district interactions and spillover effects. The results show that municipal revenues, urban infrastructure quality, demographic characteristics, and socioeconomic conditions significantly shape dry waste generation patterns and outcomes consistent with elements of circular economy behaviour. Higher municipal revenues and improved infrastructure (measured through both incident reports and the availability of public green spaces) are associated with lower per capita dry waste, with notable positive spillover effects on neighbouring districts. Demographic factors, particularly family size, also influence waste outcomes linked to circularity, while traditional lifestyles and poverty exhibit intertwined and mixed effects. The COVID-19 pandemic further contributed to temporary reductions in dry waste generation, with spatially diffused impacts across districts. Spatial panel results highlight strong inter-district dependencies, underscoring the importance of regional coordination in CE policy design. Overall, the study demonstrates that effective CE strategies in urban areas require integrated economic, infrastructural, and social interventions, alongside collaborative governance across districts.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了2019至2023年间德黑兰22个区循环经济实践相关的社会、经济、文化和基础设施因素。以记录的干垃圾产生量作为循环经济行为某些维度的不完全代理指标，分析采用常规及空间面板数据模型，以捕捉区域间互动与溢出效应。结果显示，市政收入、城市基础设施质量、人口特征和社会经济条件显著影响干垃圾产生模式及与循环经济行为要素相符的结果。较高的市政收入和改善的基础设施（通过事件报告和公共绿地可用性衡量）与人均干垃圾减少相关，并对邻近区域产生显著的正向溢出效应。人口因素，尤其是家庭规模，也影响与循环性相关的垃圾结果，而传统生活方式和贫困则表现出交织且混合的影响。新冠疫情进一步导致干垃圾产生量暂时减少，其影响在区域间呈空间扩散。空间面板结果凸显了区域间强烈的相互依赖性，强调了循环经济政策设计中区域协调的重要性。总体而言，研究表明，城市有效的循环经济策略需要经济、基础设施和社会干预的综合措施，以及跨区域的协作治理。
title: Patterns associated with circular economy practices: socioeconomic and infrastructural insights from Tehran

abstract: This study examines the impact of clean production on export product quality by focusing on a key whole-process environmental regulation policy in China. Using a difference-in-differences approach and firm-level microdata, we find that the policy significantly improves export product quality and can explain 3.3% of the one standard deviation change in the export product quality of firms covered by the policy. Mechanism analysis shows that the policy functions through three interconnected channels: factor reallocation in source prevention, innovation compensation in production processes, and product transformation in end-of-pipe treatment. Additional analysis reveals stronger positive impacts on non-state-owned firms, large firms, and firms located in regions with high environmental regulation intensity. This study highlights the significant environmental and economic benefits of shifting from end-of-pipe pollution control to process control in production. abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于中国一项关键的全过程环境规制政策，探讨清洁生产对出口产品质量的影响。采用双重差分法与企业层面微观数据，我们发现该政策显著提升了出口产品质量，并能解释受政策覆盖企业出口产品质量一个标准差变动的3.3%。机制分析表明，该政策通过三个相互关联的渠道发挥作用：源头预防中的要素重新配置、生产过程中的创新补偿以及末端治理中的产品转型。进一步分析显示，该政策对非国有企业、大型企业以及位于环境规制强度较高地区的企业具有更强的正向影响。本研究凸显了从末端污染控制转向生产过程控制所带来的显著环境与经济效益。关键词：清洁生产；环境规制；产品质量；末端治理；JEL分类：F10 F12 F18 致谢：我们感谢意得辑（www.editage.cn）提供的英文语言编辑服务。所有作者均对本研究做出了重要贡献。材料准备、数据收集与分析由陶林和明晓清完成。论文初稿由明晓清、陶林和刘贝利撰写，所有作者对先前版本的手稿提出了意见。

abstract: A better understanding of the effectiveness of grassroots coping measures against existing shocks is essential in case similar events arise in the future. This study examines how rural villages coped with off-farm employment shocks during the COVID-19 pandemic, using a panel dataset of 800 households in 100 villages across 25 counties in five provinces. Our data show that between the COVID-19 outbreak and April 2020, up to 81% of villages adopted at least one measure to support off-farm employment, such as providing job information, job offers and transportation subsidies or services. Regression results from both Propensity Score Matching and Instrumental Variable approaches consistently show that providing job information with job offers significantly reduced the probability of exiting off-farm employment and reducing working hours. Providing job information alone also reduced the probability of working fewer hours, but with little heterogeneous effects by gender, education or the village’s economic status. These findings provide valuable insights for other developing countries and can help inform policymakers about the effectiveness of grassroots responses to off-farm employment shocks. abstract: Concentrated animal feeding operations (CAFOs) provide low-cost products but often face local opposition due to environmental externalities. Based on a two-time panel discrete choice experiment (DCE) of rural residents living near CAFOs in China, this study quantifies how water quality information disclosure and various means of compensation affect residents’ acceptance of local CAFO development. The findings reveal that: (1) Compensation programmes incorporating quasi-public goods and environmental offsets can improve residents’ acceptance of CAFOs, with environmental offsets yielding the highest utility to respondents. (2) Water quality information disclosure heightens legitimate risk awareness, increasing the likelihood of opting out and rejecting CAFO construction. When the contribution of crop production to water pollution is clarified, residents receiving favourable water quality testing results show a higher willingness to accept CAFO development than those receiving unfavourable testing results. These results suggest that policymakers should prioritize environmental offsets, strengthen environmental regulation to ensure compliance, and provide the public with objective interpretations of risks. This study offers valuable insights for promoting sustainable CAFO development in China and economies with similar institutional contexts. abstract_zh: 集约化畜禽养殖场（CAFOs）提供低成本产品，但常因环境外部性而面临当地居民的反对。基于对中国CAFOs周边农村居民开展的两期面板离散选择实验（DCE），本研究量化了水质信息披露及不同补偿方式对居民接受当地CAFOs开发意愿的影响。研究发现：（1）纳入准公共物品与环境补偿的补偿方案能够提升居民对CAFOs的接受度，其中环境补偿为受访者带来最高效用。（2）水质信息披露增强了居民的合法风险意识，提高了选择退出并拒绝CAFOs建设的可能性。当明确作物生产对水污染的贡献时，获得有利水质检测结果的居民比获得不利检测结果的居民表现出更高的CAFOs开发接受意愿。上述结果表明，政策制定者应优先考虑环境补偿，加强环境监管以确保合规，并向公众提供客观的风险解读。本研究为促进中国及具有相似制度背景的经济体中CAFOs的可持续发展提供了有价值的参考。关键词：集约化畜禽养殖场；信息披露；补偿方式；接受意愿 JEL分类：Q51 Q53 Q56 Q13

abstract: We argue that heightened regulation on large banks contributed to the rise in fragility of smaller banks revealed by the 2023 regional bank crisis. In 2018, regulators restricted Wells Fargo, the third largest U.S. bank, from growing its total assets. We estimate this asset cap led Wells Fargo to give up deposits amounting to 2.2% of aggregate bank deposits. These deposits, primarily uninsured, were reallocated to banks geographically proximate to Wells Fargo, including smaller, less regulated banks. In turn, these banks experienced higher deposit outflows once monetary tightening commenced and saw their stock prices plummet during the 2023 stress. (JEL G01, G21, G28, G32, E44, E58)
abstract_zh: 我们认为，对大型银行加强监管，是2023年区域性银行危机所揭示的较小银行脆弱性上升的一个因素。2018年，监管机构限制美国第三大银行富国银行增加其总资产。我们估计，这一资产上限导致富国银行放弃了相当于银行业总存款2.2%的存款。这些存款，主要是未投保的，被重新分配给了与富国银行地理位置相近的银行，包括规模较小、监管较少的银行。相应地，一旦货币紧缩开始，这些银行经历了更高的存款外流，并在2023年的压力期间股价暴跌。(JEL G01, G21, G28, G32, E44, E58)
title: Size-Based Regulation and Bank Fragility: Evidence from the Wells Fargo Asset Cap

abstract: Larger firms feature (i) longer hours worked, (ii) higher wages, and (iii) smaller (larger) wage penalties for working long (short) hours. We reconcile these patterns in a general equilibrium model, which features the endogenous interaction of hours, wages, and firm size. In the model, workers willing to work longer hours sort into larger firms that offer a wage premium. Complementarities in hours generate wage penalties that increase with the distance from the usual hours. We use the model to argue that variation in average hours across firms contributes significantly to wage inequality.
abstract_zh: 大企业具有以下特征：（i）工作时间更长，（ii）工资更高，（iii）对长时间（短时间）工作的工资惩罚更小（更大）。我们在一个一般均衡模型中调和了这些模式，该模型包含了工作时间、工资与企业规模的内生互动。在模型中，愿意工作更长时间的工人会进入提供工资溢价的大企业。工作时间上的互补性产生了工资惩罚，这些惩罚随着与常规工作时间的距离增加而增大。我们利用该模型论证，企业间平均工作时间的差异对工资不平等有显著贡献。

abstract: Contemporary approaches to climate change adaptation increasingly emphasize multi-level stakeholder engagement. These approaches seek to advance sustainability, equity, and inclusion while addressing the social, environmental, economic, and political needs of present and future generations. Although technocratic adaptation addresses biophysical climate risks, it often neglects socio-political forces that shape vulnerability and can intensify long-term climate risks and inequalities. This paper utilizes a multi-level governance framework to examine the political dimensions of climate adaptation, focusing on the dynamics of authority, knowledge, and resource access. Building on literature on the political dimensions of climate change adaptation, this study draws on ethnographic data to examine how power is exercised, negotiated, and resisted across multiple governance scales in Nepal. Focusing on the Karnali region, it shows that despite formally democratic multi-level institutions, adaptation authority remains centralized at the federal level and shaped by corruption, reinforcing exclusion and elite capture. As federal, provincial, and local governments compete over authority, knowledge production, and resource control, Nepal’s multi-level adaptation governance reinforces power differentials and elite influence while marginalizing vulnerable communities, thereby limiting transformative and just climate adaptation. This paper argues that effective adaptation requires accountable multi-level governance rather than decentralization alone. Meaningful subnational authority must be matched by cross-scale coordination, transparency, and oversight so that decision-making, resources, and knowledge are not captured by elites at any level.
abstract_zh: 当代气候变化适应方法日益强调多层级利益相关者的参与。这些方法旨在推进可持续性、公平与包容，同时满足当代及未来世代在社会、环境、经济和政治方面的需求。尽管技术官僚式的适应措施应对了生物物理气候风险，却往往忽视了塑造脆弱性的社会政治力量，并可能加剧长期气候风险与不平等。本文运用多层级治理框架，审视气候适应的政治维度，重点关注权力、知识与资源获取的动态关系。基于气候变化适应政治维度的相关文献，本研究利用民族志数据，考察权力如何在尼泊尔多个治理层级中被行使、协商与抵制。聚焦卡尔纳利地区的研究表明，尽管存在形式上民主的多层级机构，适应权力仍集中于联邦层面，并受腐败影响，从而强化了排斥与精英俘获现象。随着联邦、省和地方政府在权力、知识生产及资源控制上相互竞争，尼泊尔的多层级适应治理强化了权力差异与精英影响力，同时边缘化了脆弱社区，从而限制了变革性和公正的气候适应。本文认为，有效的适应需要问责制的多层级治理，而非仅靠权力下放。有意义的地方层级权力必须与跨层级协调、透明度和监督相匹配，以确保决策、资源和知识不被任何层级的精英所垄断。
title: The politics of climate adaptation in Nepal: authority, knowledge, and resource inequality in multi-level governance
title_zh: 尼泊尔气候适应的政治：多层治理中的权威、知识与资源不平等

abstract: We show that quantitative asset pricing models, built to address the equity premium and risk-free rate puzzles, systematically fail when applied to open economies: they cannot generate the large and persistent interest rate differentials we observe between risky and safe currencies. This failure stems from the key mechanism that produces their success in matching both closed-economy puzzles: In these models, the mean of the stochastic discount factor offsets its variance nearly one-for-one, which immobilizes interest rates --- so that differences in expected currency returns across countries must arise almost exclusively from predictable changes in exchange rates, at odds with the data. We prove this result in a broad class of models that allows for market incompleteness and exchange rate disconnect, requiring only that each country's risk-free asset is priced by investors who demand compensation for risk in line with observed risk premia. We argue this tension between canonical asset pricing and international macroeconomic models is a key reason researchers have struggled to reconcile the observed behavior of exchange rates, interest rates, and capital flows across countries.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，旨在解决股权溢价和无风险利率之谜的定量资产定价模型，在应用于开放经济体时系统性地失效：它们无法生成我们在风险货币与安全货币之间观察到的大幅且持续的利率差异。这一失败源于使这些模型在匹配封闭经济体两大谜题时成功的关键机制：在这些模型中，随机贴现因子的均值几乎一对一地抵消其方差，从而固定了利率——因此，各国间预期货币回报的差异几乎必须完全来源于可预测的汇率变动，这与数据不符。我们在一个广泛的模型类别中证明了这一结果，该类别允许市场不完全性和汇率脱钩，仅要求每个国家的无风险资产由那些根据观察到的风险溢价要求风险补偿的投资者定价。我们认为，经典资产定价与国际宏观经济模型之间的这种张力，是研究者们难以调和各国间汇率、利率和资本流动观察行为的关键原因。
title: A Currency Premium Puzzle

abstract: This paper develops a calibrated general-equilibrium model to study how different configurations of trade and financial policy reshape the hierarchy of global currencies --- and the U.S. dollar's position at its anchor. Currency safety and anchor status arise endogenously from each economy's 'effective size' — the weight its domestic shocks carry in setting world prices. Tariffs reduce this effective size on the goods side; capital controls do the same on the financial side. A unifying result emerges: The economy that maintains the deepest integration with the global trading network retains the largest safety premium and gains anchor status. We use this framework to evaluate the effects of three policy levers for Europe that affect the effective size of the euro: internal harmonization and enlargement, trade openness, and capital-account openness. The stakes are large: In our model, shifts in currencies' safety can redirect global capital flows and alter sovereign borrowing costs by hundreds of billions of dollars annually.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个校准的一般均衡模型，用以研究贸易与金融政策的不同配置如何重塑全球货币的层级结构——以及美元在其锚定位置上的地位。货币的安全性与锚定地位内生于各经济体的“有效规模”——即其国内冲击在世界价格决定中所占的权重。关税在商品层面削弱了这一有效规模；资本管制则在金融层面产生相同效应。一个统一的结果由此显现：与全球贸易网络保持最深层次融合的经济体，将保留最大的安全溢价并赢得锚定地位。我们利用这一框架评估了影响欧元有效规模的三个欧洲政策杠杆的效果：内部协调与扩大、贸易开放度以及资本账户开放度。其影响重大：在我们的模型中，货币安全性的变动可引导全球资本流动，并每年改变主权借贷成本达数千亿美元。

abstract: Institutions that claim to reward merit often also serve as engines that drive the formation of important social networks. We examine this dual role in China’s Imperial Examination, one of history’s longest-lived meritocratic systems. We draw on exam performance data for 24,269 individuals across 112 national examinations in the Qing dynasty (1644–1905) and trace who among them rose to become top officials. Strong exam performance increased the likelihood of attaining high office, but advancement also depended on individuals’ ties to powerful examiners. Because performance and ties to powerful examiners were strongly complementary, individuals’ success appeared to rest on merit even as social networks played a role. Following the major political transformations of the 1840s, the importance of examiner ties persisted, although the influential examiners themselves changed. These findings help explain why such systems retain legitimacy even when networks matter greatly.
abstract_zh: 宣称奖励才能的制度，往往同时也充当着构建重要社会网络的引擎。我们通过中国科举制度——历史上寿命最长的精英选拔体系之一——来审视这一双重角色。我们利用清朝（1644-1905年）112次全国考试中24,269人的考试成绩数据，追踪其中谁晋升为高级官员。优异的考试成绩增加了获得高官职位的机会，但晋升同样依赖于个人与有权势考官的联系。由于考试成绩与考官关系紧密互补，个人的成功看似基于才能，即便社会网络也发挥着作用。在19世纪40年代重大政治变革之后，考官关系的重要性持续存在，尽管有影响力的考官本身发生了变化。这些发现有助于解释为何此类制度即便在网络因素影响显著时仍能保持其合法性。

abstract: Administrative review protects legality and contestability in public procurement, but it may also delay public investment, alter the choices of contracting authorities and generate defensive responses by public administrations. This paper studies these effects by linking the universe of Italian procurement procedures to newly released administrative-court records for 2023–2025. Appeals concern only 0.4 percent of procedures but 7.2 percent of tendered value and are concentrated in large, competitive contracts. Using matched duration models, we show that litigated procedures are associated with award times more than 35 percent longer than comparable procedures without appeals and that public works also reach construction-site opening later. Being subject to an appeal has sizeable effects on the subsequent behavior of contracting authorities, as they publish fewer (-30 percent) and smaller (-55 percent on average) public-works tenders and shift away from open procedures toward direct awards. These changes are larger among municipalities with lower administrative capacity. The evidence points to an enforcement-capacity trade-off: administrative review safeguards procurement integrity, but its administrative burden can slow implementation and induce defensive behavior where state capacity is weak.
abstract_zh: 行政诉讼审查保障了公共采购中的合法性与可争议性，但同时也可能延迟公共投资、改变采购机关的选择，并引发公共行政部门的防御性反应。本文通过将意大利采购程序的总体数据与2023至2025年间新发布的行政法院记录相链接，研究了这些效应。上诉仅涉及0.4%的程序，但占招标价值的7.2%，且集中于大型、竞争性合同中。利用匹配持续时间模型，我们表明，涉诉程序的中标时间比无上诉的可比程序长超过35%，且公共工程到达施工场地开工的时间也更晚。受到上诉影响对采购机关后续行为产生显著效应，它们发布的公共工程招标数量减少（-30%），规模缩小（平均-55%），并从公开招标程序转向直接授予。这些变化在行政能力较低的市政当局中更为显著。证据指向一种执行能力权衡：行政诉讼审查保障了采购的完整性，但其行政负担可能减缓实施进度，并在国家能力薄弱之处诱发防御性行为。
title: Administrative litigation and public procurement outcomes: Evidence from Italy
title_zh: 行政诉讼与公共采购结果：来自意大利的证据

abstract: This paper develops a theory of balanced growth and optimal climate policy in an integrated assessment framework. Balanced growth is possible despite climate change, but at a slower rate. Two distinct policy regimes emerge because emissions permanently raise carbon stocks. For low damages, optimal growth coincides with the laissez-faire and carbon is priced at a constant rate. For high damages, optimal policy caps temperature growth to prevent escalating losses and achieve faster economic growth than in the laissez-faire by pricing carbon at an increasing rate. We quantify our model and show that empirical damage estimates span both regimes. For low damages, optimal policy achieves a 1% welfare gain with 3 to 8°C of warming per century and no change in long-run growth. For high damages, optimal policy raises annual growth by 0.8 percentage points and achieves a 26% welfare gain by capping warming at 0.4°C per century.
abstract_zh: 本文在综合评估框架下构建了平衡增长与最优气候政策的理论。尽管存在气候变化，平衡增长仍可实现，但增速放缓。由于排放永久性提升碳存量，出现了两种截然不同的政策机制。在低损害情形下，最优增长与自由放任政策一致，碳定价保持恒定比率。在高损害情形下，最优政策限制温度增长以防止损失加剧，并通过递增的碳定价实现比自由放任更快的经济增长。我们对模型进行了量化分析，表明实证损害估计跨越了这两种机制。在低损害情形下，最优政策实现1%的福利增益，每世纪升温3至8摄氏度，且长期增长无变化。在高损害情形下，最优政策将年度增长率提高0.8个百分点，并通过将每世纪升温限制在0.4摄氏度，实现26%的福利增益。
title: Balancing Growth in a Warming World
title_zh: 变暖世界中的增长平衡

abstract: We examine how liberalizing inheritance law can affect the diffusion of wealth beyond family dynasties. Exploiting a reform that reduced mandatory estate shares for children and surviving parents, we analyze testator responses in a unique dataset of 16,887 anonymous online wills. We find that greater testamentary freedom led testators to increase transfers primarily to spouses and life partners, but also to nonrelatives and charitable organizations. Our estimated ’marginal diffusion propensity’ reveals that, for each additional percentage point of freely disposable wealth, approximately one third was reallocated towards recipients outside the core family. Extrapolating this effect suggests that liberalization could result in additional annual extra-dynastic bequests of up to 0.8% of national income in countries with restrictive inheritance rules.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了放宽继承法如何影响财富在家族王朝之外的扩散。利用一项减少子女及在世父母法定继承份额的改革，我们分析了一个包含16,887份匿名在线遗嘱的独特数据集中立遗嘱人的反应。我们发现，更大的遗嘱自由促使立遗嘱人主要增加对配偶及生活伴侣的转移，同时也向非亲属和慈善组织转移。我们估算的“边际扩散倾向”显示，每增加一个百分点的自由支配财富，大约有三分之一被重新分配至核心家庭之外的受益人。将此效应外推表明，在继承规则严格的国家，放宽继承法可能导致每年额外高达国民收入0.8%的跨王朝遗赠。
title: Unfree Wills: Inheritance Rules, Bequest Motives, and Wealth Diffusion
title_zh: 不自由的遗嘱：继承规则、遗赠动机与财富扩散

abstract: We study how the specification of wage risk in quantitative life-cycle models changes the welfare evaluation of taxes and transfers. We estimate four wage processes: a canonical linear process; a flexible nonlinear process with age dependence, non-normality, and state-dependent persistence; and two intermediate processes. Comparisons across the four isolate the role of each feature: age dependence, non-normality, and nonlinear persistence. The estimated processes imply different allocations of wage risk across permanent, persistent, and transitory components: the richer processes assign less risk to short-lived transitory shocks and more to long-lived permanent and persistent components. We embed each process in the same incomplete-markets life-cycle economy with endogenous labor supply. Removing federal tax progressivity and means-tested transfers raises mean welfare by $0.72%$ of lifetime consumption under the nonlinear process but lowers it by $0.47%$ under the non-normal process. These welfare differences reflect both the total amount of wage risk and its allocation across permanent heterogeneity, persistent shocks, and transitory shocks. Holding this amount and allocation fixed, non-normal shocks create rare but severe low-income states that increase the value of public insurance, while the state-dependent mean reversion that characterizes the nonlinear specification works in the opposite direction: unusually bad persistent states tend to be undone by subsequent favorable shocks, so the wage process partly insures itself, and that lowers the value of public insurance.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了定量生命周期模型中工资风险设定如何改变税收与转移支付的福利评估。我们估计了四种工资过程：一种典型线性过程；一种包含年龄依赖性、非正态性和状态依赖持续性的灵活非线性过程；以及两种中间过程。通过四种过程的比较，我们隔离了各特征的作用：年龄依赖性、非正态性和非线性持续性。估计出的过程在永久性、持续性和暂时性成分之间分配工资风险的方式不同：更丰富的过程将较少风险分配给短期暂时性冲击，而将更多风险分配给长期永久性和持续性成分。我们将每种过程嵌入同一具有内生劳动供给的不完全市场生命周期经济中。在非线性过程下，取消联邦税收累进性和基于经济状况调查的转移支付使平均福利提高终身消费的$0.72\%$，但在非正态过程下则降低$0.47\%$。这些福利差异既反映了工资风险的总量，也反映了其在永久性异质性、持续性冲击和暂时性冲击之间的分配。在保持总量和分配不变的情况下，非正态冲击创造了罕见但严重的低收入状态，增加了公共保险的价值；而表征非线性设定的状态依赖性均值回归则起相反作用：异常糟糕的持续性状态往往被随后的有利冲击所抵消，因此工资过程部分自我保险，这降低了公共保险的价值。
title: Taxes and Transfers with Nonlinear Wage Dynamics
title_zh: 非线性工资动态下的税收与转移支付

abstract: Tax avoidance through personal holding companies has long been viewed as a key challenge for progressive income taxation. We exploit twenty years of administrative micro-data linking firms to owners in Sweden and Norway to analyze how the use of personal holding companies varies across the income distribution and to quantify its implications in a quasi-experimental setting. About half of the income of the top 0.1% is retained in personal holding companies defined, as in US tax law, as firms for which five or fewer owners own more than 50% of the stock and that derive more than 60% of income from investment income. Event studies of shocks to operational firms' value-added show that holding companies shield around half of dividend distributions from individual income taxation. Profits tend to remain in holding companies for long periods of time, with cumulative payout rates of 15%-20% over two decades for the highest income groups. Wealth taxes do not provide an effective backstop due to the low valuation (or exemption) of shares in private businesses. As a result, effective tax rates, all taxes included, fall from about 50% for the upper middle class to about 15%-20% among the highest-net-worth individuals.
abstract_zh: 通过个人控股公司进行避税长期以来一直被视为累进所得税制面临的关键挑战。我们利用瑞典和挪威二十年间将企业与所有者关联的行政微观数据，分析个人控股公司的使用如何随收入分配变化，并在准实验环境中量化其影响。根据美国税法定义，个人控股公司指由五名或更少所有者持有超过50%股份，且超过60%收入来源于投资收入的企业。在最高收入0.1%群体中，约一半收入留存于此类控股公司。对经营性企业增加值冲击的事件研究表明，控股公司能规避约一半股息分配的个人所得税。利润往往长期留存于控股公司，最高收入群体在二十年间的累计派息率仅为15%-20%。由于私人企业股份估值偏低（或免税），财富税无法有效弥补这一漏洞。因此，包括所有税收在内的有效税率，从中上阶层的约50%降至最高净值个人的约15%-20%。
title: Personal Holding Companies, Tax Progressivity, and Inequality
title_zh: 个人控股公司、税收累进性与不平等

abstract: Solar mandates are spreading rapidly. We leverage California’s frontrunner experience to examine their economics. First, we parameterize an engineering model to estimate private payoffs from solar adoption in residential new construction. Second, we test for a “solar gap” by comparing payoffs with observed adoption. Although estimated payoffs are generally positive, adoption varies widely. Most buildings do not adopt solar despite positive estimated payoffs, which explain little of the variation in adoption decisions. Third, we evaluate San Francisco’s citywide and California’s statewide mandates. Both mandates increased solar adoption considerably.
abstract_zh: 太阳能强制令正在迅速普及。我们利用加利福尼亚州的先行者经验来考察其经济效应。首先，我们对一个工程模型进行参数化，以估算住宅新建项目中采用太阳能的私人回报。其次，通过比较回报与实际采用情况，我们检验是否存在“太阳能缺口”。尽管估算的回报普遍为正，但采用情况差异显著。多数建筑即便估算回报为正也未采用太阳能，而这些回报对采用决策差异的解释力有限。第三，我们评估了旧金山市全市及加利福尼亚州全州的强制令。两项强制令均显著提升了太阳能的采用率。
title: Solar Adoption by Mandates
title_zh: 强制要求下的太阳能采用：DP21808

abstract: Tariffs raise the prices of goods made at home, not just the imports they tax—an effect that standard pass-through estimates largely miss. Studying the 2025 U.S. tariffs, we find that about 26 percent of the tariff increase passes through to consumer prices. These estimates are measured relative to less-exposed goods and hold aggregate conditions fixed. The direct effect accounts for 64 percent of this increase, as tariffs raise the consumer prices of foreign varieties of a good. The remaining 36 percent arises indirectly—tariffs raise the cost of imported inputs used by U.S. producers, and domestic producers raise their markups because they face less competition from higher-priced imports. The direct effect passes through quickly, since tariffs raise import prices almost immediately, but the indirect effect takes nine to twelve months to work its way through supply chains. As a result, tariffs have a larger and more drawn-out impact on consumers than the direct effect alone would suggest.
abstract_zh: 关税不仅提高了其所征税的进口商品的价格，也抬高了国内生产的商品价格——这一效应在标准的汇率传导估计中大多被忽视。通过研究2025年美国关税，我们发现约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格。这些估计是相对于受关税影响较小的商品进行衡量的，并保持总体经济条件不变。直接效应占这一增幅的64%，因为关税提高了某一商品外国品种的消费者价格。其余36%则间接产生——关税提高了美国生产商使用的进口投入品成本，而国内生产商因面临来自高价进口商品的竞争减少而提高其加成率。直接效应传导迅速，因为关税几乎立即推高了进口价格，但间接效应需要九至十二个月才能通过供应链逐步显现。因此，关税对消费者的影响比仅考虑直接效应所暗示的更为显著且持续时间更长。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为2025年美国关税及其对消费者价格的影响，数据与制度背景均属美国，未涉及中国。
title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
title_zh: 关税传导至消费者价格的结构解析

abstract: We utilize Chinese provincial data to explore how government policies affected grain production between 1952 and 2008. We adapt the Caselli‐Coleman framework to allow multiple inputs including fertilizer, land and capital as well as skilled and unskilled labour. We also extend the method to allow for comparisons of production possibilities over time as well as across provinces. We derive measures of the technological frontier for Chinese agricultural production for each year over the 56‐year period. The empirical estimates illustrate how labour efficiency in Chinese grain production changed from 1952 to 2008, encompassing the Great Leap Forward (1958–1962), the collective farming period (1963–1977), and the rural economic reforms initiated in 1978. Government policies held back agricultural production in the 1960s and 1970s by limiting efficient use of labour at a time when the Green Revolution was raising grain yields dramatically throughout Asia. Reductions in labour efficiency led to a 12.9% average decline in grain output during the Great Leap Forward and little gain during the collective farming period. In contrast, rural reforms that allowed farmers to profit from production above their assigned quotas starting in 1978 significantly enhanced labour efficiency for the more skilled but had little impact on the productive efficiency of unskilled agricultural workers.
abstract_zh: 我们利用中国省级数据，探讨了1952年至2008年间政府政策如何影响粮食生产。我们调整了卡塞利-科尔曼框架，以纳入包括化肥、土地和资本以及熟练与非熟练劳动力在内的多种投入要素。同时，我们扩展了该方法，以便在时间维度和省份间进行生产可能性比较。我们推导出了这56年间中国农业生产技术前沿的度量指标。实证估计展示了1952年至2008年间中国粮食生产中劳动力效率的变化，涵盖了“大跃进”时期（1958-1962年）、集体耕作时期（1963-1977年）以及1978年启动的农村经济改革。政府政策在20世纪60年代和70年代限制了劳动力的有效利用，而此时绿色革命正大幅提高整个亚洲的粮食产量，从而阻碍了农业生产。劳动力效率的下降导致“大跃进”期间粮食产量平均下降12.9%，而在集体耕作时期增长甚微。相比之下，自1978年起允许农民从超出分配定额的生产中获利的农村改革，显著提升了技能较高劳动力的效率，但对非熟练农业工人的生产效率影响甚微。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Government Policy, Low‐ and High‐Skilled Labour, and Technical Inefficiency in Chinese Agriculture, 1952–2008
title_zh: 中国政府政策、高低技能劳动力与中国农业技术效率（1952—2008）

abstract: We study the fertility effects of the 1997 Quebec Family Policy using two complementary approaches: (i) a period‐based repeated cross‐sectional analysis that examines the impact on period fertility (i.e., fertility rates in a given calendar year, such as births per 1,000 women age 15 to 49), and (ii) a cohort‐based panel analysis that examines the impact on completed fertility for specific cohorts. Using aggregate vital statistics (1991–2019) and the synthetic control method, the period analysis indicates a long‐run increase in period fertility, which may reflect both shifts in the timing of childbearing and changes in completed fertility among affected cohorts. To assess completed fertility, we conduct panel analysis using a 20% sample of Canadian tax returns and a dynamic difference‐in‐differences approach. For two relatively older cohorts of women who already entered reproductive years before the reform, we find that the policy reduced completed fertility while increasing their labour supply. Taken together, the findings show that the policy raised period fertility but lowered completed fertility for certain cohorts, indicating that its effects depend on the life‐cycle stage at which women were exposed.
abstract_zh: 我们采用两种互补方法研究1997年魁北克家庭政策的生育效应：（i）基于时期的重复横截面分析，考察其对时期生育率（即特定日历年的生育率，如每千名15至49岁女性的出生人数）的影响；（ii）基于队列的面板分析，考察其对特定队列完成生育率的影响。利用汇总生命统计数据（1991-2019年）和合成控制法，时期分析表明时期生育率出现长期上升，这可能既反映了生育时间安排的转变，也反映了受影响队列完成生育率的变化。为评估完成生育率，我们使用加拿大税务申报表的20%样本和动态双重差分法进行面板分析。对于改革前已进入育龄期的两个相对较年长的女性队列，我们发现该政策降低了其完成生育率，同时增加了其劳动供给。综合来看，研究结果表明该政策提高了时期生育率，但降低了特定队列的完成生育率，表明其效应取决于女性暴露于政策时所处的生命周期阶段。
title: Fertility incentives in Canada: Period and cohort perspectives
title_zh: 加拿大生育激励措施：时期与队列视角

abstract: This paper estimates the average causal effect of access to subsidized before‐ and after‐school care on the labour market outcomes of mothers. Specifically, we analyze a major policy reform implemented in Quebec (Canada) in 1998, which required all public primary schools to provide before‐ and after‐school care at a low fixed fee, thereby reducing costs and expanding availability for families. We identify the intent‐to‐treat effect of the reform on service use and maternal labour market outcomes using administrative tax return data and a triple difference design. We find that, 7 years after implementation, the policy led to a substantial increase in mothers' use of childcare programs and raised their average annual labour income by 7%. These income gains are primarily driven by higher income among working mothers, rather than increased employment rates.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了获得补贴性课前课后照护对母亲劳动力市场结果的平均因果效应。具体而言，我们分析了1998年在加拿大魁北克实施的一项重大政策改革，该改革要求所有公立小学以低固定费用提供课前课后照护，从而降低了家庭成本并扩大了服务可及性。我们利用行政税务申报数据和三重差分设计，识别了该改革对服务使用及母亲劳动力市场结果的意向性治疗效应。研究发现，在实施7年后，该政策显著增加了母亲对儿童照护项目的使用，并使其年均劳动收入提高了7%。这些收入增长主要源于在职母亲收入的增加，而非就业率的提升。
title: Impact of after‐school care on maternal income: Evidence from Canadian administrative data
title_zh: 课外托管对母亲收入的影响：来自加拿大行政数据的证据

abstract: We develop a Hotelling duopoly model of competition on a gatekeeper platform in which firms choose between uniform pricing and personalized pricing. Implementing personalized pricing requires access to a platform-provided pricing technology and entails a per-transaction fee set by the platform. The platform also designs rankings and recommendations that affect the distribution of consumers between loyal and marginal types. We show that the platform may strategically reshape the demand environment to make personalized pricing more attractive to firms and thereby raise the fee it can charge. By reallocating mass from loyal to marginal and more disloyal consumers, the platform intensifies competition under uniform pricing and relaxes firms’ adoption constraint. Excessive centralization, however, erodes the rents that sustain fee extraction, so the platform chooses an interior degree of demand centralization. Relative to a no-manipulation benchmark, this reallocates surplus toward the gatekeeper and away from firms and consumers. When the platform also appropriates a share of seller profits, its incentives may reverse: it may favor loyalty-enhancing designs that soften downstream competition. The analysis highlights how platform monetization and recommendation design jointly determine downstream competition and its welfare consequences.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个霍特林双寡头竞争模型，研究企业在守门人平台上选择统一定价与个性化定价的竞争行为。实施个性化定价需要获取平台提供的定价技术，并支付平台设定的每笔交易费用。平台还设计排名和推荐机制，影响消费者在忠诚型与边缘型之间的分布。研究表明，平台可能策略性地重塑需求环境，使个性化定价对企业更具吸引力，从而提高其可收取的费用。通过将消费者从忠诚型重新分配至边缘型及更不忠诚的群体，平台加剧了统一定价下的竞争，并放宽了企业的采纳约束。然而，过度集中化会侵蚀支撑费用提取的租金，因此平台会选择适度的需求集中程度。与无操纵基准相比，这种重新分配将剩余向守门人转移，而减少企业和消费者的剩余。当平台同时抽取卖方利润的一部分时，其激励可能发生逆转：平台可能倾向于增强忠诚度的设计，以缓和下游竞争。分析揭示了平台货币化与推荐设计如何共同决定下游竞争及其福利后果。
title: Gatekeepers and the Endogenous Design of Consumer Preferences under Personalized Pricing
title_zh: 个性化定价下守门人与消费者偏好的内生设计

abstract: China’s technological progress in recent decades has been viewed with admiration, alarm, and (in some cases) doubt. To better understand the Chinese innovation ecosystem, we compile a dataset of almost 14 million domestic Chinese patent publications. We focus on the subset of critical technologies identified by the U.S. Department of Defense. Several surprising patterns emerge from the data: Chinese patenting is strongly associated with other measures of innovative progress; patents are not concentrated in corporate giants such as Huawei; universities have played a key role in innovation, much greater than state-owned enterprises or government-owned facilities; and fewer than one in ten Chinese critical technology patents involves an inventor with U.S. experience or training. Finally, using four text-based measures of patent quality, we show that the rise of Chinese patenting in critical technologies has not been associated with a decline in quality relative to the U.S. awards.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，中国的技术进步既受到赞赏，也引发警觉，有时甚至招致质疑。为更深入地理解中国的创新生态系统，我们汇编了一个包含近1400万件中国国内专利出版物的数据集，并聚焦于美国国防部认定的关键技术子集。数据揭示了几个令人意外的模式：中国专利活动与其他创新进展指标紧密相关；专利并非集中于华为等企业巨头；大学在创新中扮演了关键角色，其作用远超国有企业或政府所属机构；在关键技术的中国专利中，拥有美国经验或培训背景的发明人不足十分之一。最后，通过四种基于文本的专利质量衡量指标，我们表明，中国在关键技术领域专利数量的增长并未伴随相对于美国授权专利的质量下降。

title: Chinese Sputnik Moments?
title_zh: 中国的斯普特尼克时刻？

abstract: The study of bureaucracy as a key dimension of state capacity has gained increasing attention in economics. What organizational features create an effective bureaucracy, however, remains subject to debate. This paper focuses on the central role of civil service protections in delineating the boundary between politics and administration. I introduce a simple principal-agent framework to discuss the key theoretical channels through which political insulation can shape bureaucrat performance. Guided by the framework, I establish stylized facts and organize evidence from historical and contemporary civil service reforms. Overall, the micro-level evidence documents a positive effect of civil service protections on the quality of public service delivery. I conclude with open questions about the political economy of reform adoption.
abstract_zh: 官僚制作为国家能力的关键维度，其研究在经济学中日益受到关注。然而，何种组织特征能造就有效的官僚体系，仍是争论焦点。本文聚焦于公务员保护在界定政治与行政边界中的核心作用。我引入一个简洁的委托-代理框架，探讨政治隔离影响官僚绩效的主要理论渠道。在此框架指导下，我确立了若干典型事实，并系统整理了历史及当代公务员制度改革的相关证据。总体而言，微观层面的证据表明，公务员保护对公共服务供给质量具有积极影响。最后，我提出关于改革采纳的政治经济学未解问题。
title: The Economics of Civil Service Protections
title_zh: 公务员保护的经济学

abstract: Behavioral interventions have become central to modern public policy, but their empirical promise remains contested because estimated treatment effects often appear small. We argue that a policy response is economically meaningful only relative to the response generated by alternative policies. We assemble more than 1,200 estimates from over 600 studies comparing “nudges” and traditional price interventions in the markets for cigarettes, alcohol, influenza vaccination, electricity, and residential water. Translating nudge effects into equivalent price changes, we find that behavioral interventions often correspond to enormous fiscal interventions, from an 11% tax on electricity to a 100% subsidy on influenza vaccinations. Nudges are also more cost-effective than price instruments in all markets, but cost-effectiveness does not predict the welfare ranking of policies. Using a behavioral extension of the Marginal Value of Public Funds, we show that nudges have high welfare returns at the margin, while price instruments often generate larger total surplus at scale.
abstract_zh: 行为干预已成为现代公共政策的核心，但其经验上的承诺仍存争议，因为估计的处理效应往往显得微小。我们认为，一项政策回应只有在与替代政策所产生的回应相比较时，才具有经济意义。我们汇集了超过600项研究中关于“助推”与传统价格干预在香烟、酒精、流感疫苗接种、电力和居民用水市场上的1200多个估计值。将助推效应转化为等价的价格变化，我们发现行为干预往往对应着巨大的财政干预，从对电力征收11%的税到对流感疫苗接种提供100%的补贴。在所有市场中，助推也比价格工具更具成本效益，但成本效益并不能预测政策的福利排序。利用公共资金边际价值的行
title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
title_zh: 行为政策的价值

abstract: We use U.S. nationally representative longitudinal data to estimate the effects of cognitive and behavioral impairments in childhood on health in adulthood. We focus on work-limiting health conditions and fair or poor self-rated health but also consider adequacy of sleep, body weight, and health behaviors (use of various substances and preventive health care) as potential pathways. In household fixed effects models, we find that both impairments are strongly associated with having a work-limiting health condition in adulthood; specifically, cognitive impairments increase the probability of a work-limiting condition by 70% and behavioral impairments increase the probability by 60%. Individuals with cognitive impairments in childhood are 43% more likely to report being in fair or poor health in adulthood compared to individuals without cognitive impairments. The effects of cognitive impairments on health do not appear to operate through insufficient sleep, obesity, or health behaviors. Individuals with childhood behavioral impairments are no more likely to report being in fair or poor health but are more likely to get insufficient sleep and to be obese, compared to individuals without behavioral impairments, suggesting that insufficient sleep and obesity could potentially lie on the pathway from behavioral impairments in childhood to work-limiting health conditions in adulthood.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国全国代表性的纵向数据，估算了童年期认知和行为障碍对成年期健康的影响。我们重点关注限制工作的健康状况及自评健康为一般或较差的情况，同时也考虑了睡眠充足性、体重及健康行为（包括各类物质使用和预防性医疗保健）作为潜在的影响途径。在家庭固定效应模型中，我们发现这两种障碍均与成年期存在限制工作的健康状况密切相关；具体而言，认知障碍使限制工作状况的概率增加70%，行为障碍则使其增加60%。与无认知障碍的个体相比，童年期有认知障碍的个体在成年期报告健康为一般或较差的可能性高出43%。认知障碍对健康的影响似乎并非通过睡眠不足、肥胖或健康行为发挥作用。相比之下，童年期有行为障碍的个体在成年期报告健康为一般或较差的可能性并未增加，但相较于无行为障碍的个体，他们更可能睡眠不足和肥胖，这表明睡眠不足和肥胖可能构成从童年期行为障碍到成年期限制工作健康状况的潜在中间路径。
title: Childhood Cognitive and Behavioral Impairments and Adult Health
title_zh: 儿童认知与行为障碍及成年期健康

abstract: We provide the first empirical evidence that common ownership can facilitate explicit collusion. Our unique setting, the population of legal cartels in Sweden, lets us observe cartel formation, duration, and dissolution without the sample-selection bias that plagues studies of detected cartels. Combining hand-collected ownership data with the universe of registered cartels, we compute firm-pair profit weights (κ) that measure how much one firm internalizes a rival's profits. Higher profit weights are associated with a greater likelihood of cartel participation, predict future cartel involvement, and are linked to longer cartel duration. Firms also reduce their profit weights immediately after a cartel dissolves. However, this relationship is concentrated among pairs in which the firm that internalizes the rival firm's profits colludes while the rival does not. Common ownership therefore complements a firm’s own participation in explicit collusion but substitutes for cartel participation by the rival whose profits it internalizes.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了首个经验证据，表明共同所有权能促进显性共谋。我们的独特研究背景——瑞典合法卡特尔全体样本——使我们能够观察卡特尔的形成、持续与解散，而避免了困扰已侦测卡特尔研究的样本选择偏差。结合手工收集的所有权数据与全部注册卡特尔记录，我们计算了企业对的利润权重（κ），该指标衡量一家企业在多大程度上内化竞争对手的利润。更高的利润权重与卡特尔参与可能性增大相关，能预测未来的卡特尔参与，并与更长的卡特尔持续时间相关联。企业在卡特尔解散后也会立即降低其利润权重。然而，这种关系集中在那些内化竞争对手利润的企业参与共谋而竞争对手未参与的企业对中。因此，共同所有权补充了企业自身在显性共谋中的参与，但替代了其利润被内化的竞争对手的卡特尔参与。
title: Common Ownership and Collusion
title_zh: 共同所有权与合谋

abstract: This article provides an overview of the literature on financial literacy. It covers the initial measurement that created the Big Three questions and measures of personal finance knowledge featuring 28 questions. It shows that levels of financial literacy are low and have not been improving over time. This is true not only in the United States but also in countries worldwide. These findings matter because financial literacy is conducive to savvy financial behaviors, from holding precautionary savings to planning for retirement to many other financial decisions. Financial education programs have grown exponentially over time, providing important insights into their cost-effectiveness. Personal finance courses have been added to high school and college curricula, and the evidence indicates that they are useful initiatives to improve financial knowledge and downstream behavior.
abstract_zh: 本文对金融素养相关文献进行了综述。它涵盖了最初构建“三大问题”的测量方法，以及包含28个问题的个人财务知识测量指标。研究表明，金融素养水平普遍较低，且随时间推移并未得到改善。这一现象不仅存在于美国，也见于全球各国。这些发现之所以重要，是因为金融素养有助于促进明智的财务行为，从持有预防性储蓄到规划退休，乃至其他众多财务决策。金融教育项目随时间呈指数级增长，为其成本效益提供了重要见解。个人理财课程已被纳入高中和大学课程体系，证据表明，这些举措对于提升财务知识及后续行为具有积极作用。
title: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
title_zh: 提升金融素养：从公司金融到个人金融

abstract: This paper incorporates the Lucas (1973) island model into a standard DSGE framework. It demonstrates that self-fulfilling stochastic inflation equilibria, which are driven by intrinsic uncertainty or pure sentiments, can exist under rational expectations. Furthermore, it shows that these sentiment-driven stochastic equilibria exhibit monetary non-neutrality, even when the fundamental equilibrium is unique and monetarily neutral. As the aggregate price or inflation rate can appear to fluctuate independently of the money supply, our model explains the complex relationship between inflation and the money supply in the real world, where the basic quantity theory of money often seems invalid.
abstract_zh: 本文将Lucas（1973）岛屿模型融入标准DSGE框架，证明在理性预期下，由内在不确定性或纯粹情绪驱动的自我实现随机通胀均衡可能存在。进一步，本文表明，即使基础均衡唯一且货币中性，这些情绪驱动的随机均衡仍表现出货币非中性。由于总体价格或通胀率看似独立于货币供应波动，本模型解释了现实世界中通胀与货币供应之间复杂的关系，其中基本货币数量论往往显得失效。
title: Incomplete Information and Self-Fulfilling Inflation Dynamics—Lucas meets Keynes
title_zh: 不完全信息与自我实现的通胀动态——卢卡斯遇见凯恩斯

abstract: This paper investigates why China’s recurrent credit expansions have coincided with persistently weak inflation. We argue that this pattern reflects the country’s production-oriented monetary regime. At the aggregate level, faster monetary-financial expansion temporarily raises PPI inflation but depresses it over longer horizons. At the sectoral level, liability growth among listed industrial firms is followed by weaker producer prices, lower profitability, higher leverage, rising inventories, and reduced capacity utilization. We also find asymmetric supply-chain transmission: downstream liability growth raises upstream PPI inflation, while upstream liability growth does not generate a corresponding downstream price response. These findings indicate that credit expansion in China tends to sustain production and balance sheets rather than stimulate final demand. As a result, monetary policy operates less as a conventional tool for demand management and durable reflation, and more as a mechanism for preserving production capacity and supporting growth.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了中国周期性信贷扩张为何与持续疲弱的通胀并存。我们认为，这一现象反映了该国以生产为导向的货币体制。在总体层面，更快的货币金融扩张短期内推高生产者价格指数（PPI）通胀，但在更长时期内则抑制之。在行业层面，上市工业企业负债增长后，伴随生产者价格走弱、盈利能力下降、杠杆率上升、库存增加及产能利用率降低。我们还发现不对称的供应链传导效应：下游负债增长推升上游PPI通胀，而上游负债增长并未引发相应的下游价格反应。这些发现表明，中国的信贷扩张倾向于维持生产和资产负债表，而非刺激最终需求。因此，货币政策更多作为保全生产能力和支持增长的一种机制，而非传统的需求管理和持久再通胀工具。
